final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_fd FROM film GROUP BY rating), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fd) AS overall FROM r) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_rc, r.avg_fd, r.avg_fd / o.overall AS ratio FROM r JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.rating
